_comment: Single flag controlling which books are hidden from the public web site. The original 교재/ markdown is never touched — this only gates what `pnpm sync` publishes to content/docs and what the app links to. To re-publish a book: delete its line below (or set it to false), then rerun `pnpm sync` (and redeploy). Read by scripts/sync-content.mjs and lib/hidden-books.ts — keep both readers pointed at this one file.
